title: PoolWatch knowledge pack
description: One known issue: what it is, the evidence that shows it on a PC, what helps, where to read more and who found it. docs/knowledge-packs.md explains each field. PoolWatch itself ignores fields it does not know, so that a pack written for a newer version still loads; this schema flags them, so a misspelt field is caught while you edit.

id.description: Lower-case letters and digits, words joined by hyphens; also the file name (id.json).

title.description: The issue's name, in plain words.

explanation.description: What is going on, in plain words.

workaround.description: What helps, in plain words. Say so plainly when PoolWatch cannot fix it.

actions.description: The built-in actions that work around the issue. Never a command, a path or a web address.

suggestion.description: Needed with actions, not allowed without: the sentence after the evidence on the action's suggestion card.

evidence.description: The ways the issue shows. It applies when any one rule holds; within a rule, every condition given must hold.

what.description: Reads on from the name: "documented the leak and its cause".

text.description: Plain text on one line, with no spaces at the start or end and no control characters. PoolWatch also refuses invisible formatting characters.

url.description: An https:// address on github.com, learn.microsoft.com or support.microsoft.com, with letters, digits and - . _ ~ : / ? # = & % + only.

tags.description: Pool tags, 1 to 4 printable characters each (a shorter tag is padded with spaces, as Windows does). Case matters: Reff and RefF are different tags.

name.description: What it is in plain words, as written in the middle of a sentence: "security tokens", "Codex desktop".

rule.description: Every condition given must hold, and each rule needs tagGrowth or clearFreed: an issue is named only on what PoolWatch measured.

tagGrowth.description: These tags together grew at least this fast, measured over the last hour or since the last cache clear (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes).

clearFreed.description: A cache clear in the last day freed at least this much of these tags together.

running.description: Any one of these programs is running.

storePackage.description: The start of its Microsoft Store package's name.

windowsBuild.description: Windows build numbers, both ends included (26100 is Windows 11 24H2).

fileSystems.description: A fixed drive has any one of these file systems.
